article.title: Hiroshi Ikeda (aikidoka)
article.coi: The requester's research project actively corresponds with dojos about Ikeda's seminar history and holds personal communications (email replies from dojo members) as first-class graph evidence. None of that personal knowledge is used as a source for the proposed wording.

gng.note: Live article exists; 5 RELIABLE sources (all Aikido Journal) + 4 MARGINAL per generated reliability report.

rationale_blocks.title: Why the personal-communication wall matters here
rationale_blocks.body: This subject is the reason the project separates evidence classes: an incorrect dojo-affiliation inference was emailed to Kristina Varjan (Kohala Aikikai), who replied that Ikeda had never visited her dojo. The denial is preserved in the graph (source:kristina-varjan-kohala-email-2026-09-24), 'visited frequently' edges are leads only, and outreach is framed confirm-or-correct.
